Media Savvy.name: Media Savvy
Media Savvy.description:
📸 You handle cameras, reporters and fans with ease, and turn attention to your advantage.

🎯 Good for pros chasing the rankings and anyone in the public eye.
📋 Requires level 16 and Media Presence 18.

📈 Grants: Media Presence +10
Media Savvy.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has been in public view enough to handle it: they give clean answers to reporters, sense a loaded question, choose what to post and turn a viral moment to their advantage. Show it in composed interviews and a public image that survives small mistakes. Limits: savvy cannot erase a real scandal, and attention draws enemies: villains, rivals and journalists digging for the story behind the image.
